justification: The ghost faithfully preserves the semantic core of the original across all key propositions: (1) the goal of graded reconstruction is not zero distortion but a residual small enough to close at the current grade and recurse (original: 'closure... not zero distortion... residual small enough... recurse to the next'; ghost: 'perfection is not the aim... wrapped up... hand a foothold to the level above'); (2) the gate flips from fidelity to recurse-readiness (original: 'gate flips from fidelity to does-the-residual-recurse'; ghost: 'question... no longer "how close is the copy" but "can the leftover be carried forward"'); (3) structured residual is target, noise is failure (original: 'good partial - structured, self-similar... target band'; 'Unstructured noise is the real loss'; ghost: 'contained enough... exactly what we want'; 'Loss that is mere scatter... genuine failure'); (4) recurse-test resists gaming better than fidelity (original: 'recurse-test is harder to fake than fidelity'; ghost: 'this test resists gaming better than a similarity score does'). The ghost rephrases throughout but inverts no claims, drops no relations, and adds no spurious assertions. Phrasing diverges significantly ('self-similar' becomes implicit in 'foothold', 'similarity score' replaces 'fidelity' as the comparison baseline) but meaning vector is stable and complete.
